info.title: aelab API
info.description: Administrator API. Responses are direct JSON objects/arrays. Errors are {error: {code, message}}. Missing/expired login is 401; Origin and CSRF failures are 403; invalid requests are 400; stale writes are 409. Mutations require the exact Origin and session CSRF token. Configuration revisions protect writes. Native command results retain exit status. Terminal tickets are single-use; connect to /ws/terminals/{ticket} and exchange binary output and JSON input/resize/signal/pin/unpin controls. Terminal metadata reports the retained ID, pin state, initial working directory and launch context. Native pins are login-owned, memory-only and expire on logout, authentication expiry or central shutdown; replay is bounded to 256 KiB. A replay metadata frame marks the following binary history frame; suppress terminal-generated input replies while rendering it.
